lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: So then, Great Saiyaman, what's your story?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm just a small-town boy with alien blood, looking to make a difference. You?

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: An agent of justice, cleaning up the city and fighting against the filth that took my mother from me.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh my gosh, criminals killed your mom?

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: Well, no, uh, I actually lost her to the Big C.

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: But that backstory doesn't exactly strike fear into the hearts of criminals.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Yeah, I lost my dad to the Big C too.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, no, I thought you meant Cell.

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: But didn't everyone mysteriously come back after he died?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Who wants to learn how to fly?
